# Superdesign

Skills that teach agents to work with Superdesign. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [superdesigndev/superdesign-skill](https://github.com/superdesigndev/superdesign-skill), at commit `f9f05cd`.

Design or redesign frontend UI, presentations and marketing graphics with Superdesign.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Superdesign**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Superdesign**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install superdesign@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skills: `superdesign`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skill works with the Superdesign service, so your design prompts go to that service.
